items.name: Dolphin-emu GameSettings Pack
items.description: A comprehensive collection of official Dolphin-emu per-game settings. Curated by sirpips, this pack provides a solid baseline for GameCube and Wii titles, ensuring optimal compatibility and performance on both original Dolphin and DolphinUI. Contains a GameSettings folder ready to be extracted.
items.author: Dolphin Team, sirpips

items.name: Dolphin-emu Graphic Mods Pack
items.description: A curated collection of all official graphic mods from the Dolphin-emu team. This pack, prepared by sirpips, includes modifications for bloom, depth of field, HUD removal, and more. Contains a GraphicMods folder ready to be extracted into your DolphinUI's Load directory.
items.author: Dolphin Team, sirpips

items.name: Swiss (GameCube)
items.description: Swiss is the Swiss Army Knife of GameCube homebrew. It is an all-in-one utility that allows you to launch games and homebrew from a variety of devices (SD Gecko, SD2SP2, IDE-EXI, USB Gecko, network shares, and more). It can force 480p video output on games that don't natively support it, provides a virtual Broadband Adapter for LAN play, and is essential for any GameCube enthusiast [citation:1][citation:4][citation:7].
items.author: emukidid, Extrems

items.name: BootMii CFG Editor
items.description: A graphical tool to edit and manage BootMii configuration files. BootMii is a bootloader for the Wii, and this editor simplifies the process of changing boot options, theme settings, and backup configurations [citation:6].
items.author: AlexDP

items.name: Calibrator
items.description: A utility for calibrating the Wii Remote and the sensor bar. It helps fix pointer accuracy issues and ensures precise cursor movement, which can be useful if you are using a third-party sensor bar or after hardware modifications.
items.author: Unknown

items.name: CFG USB Loader
items.description: A popular USB loader for launching Wii games from external drives. It supports multiple formats (ISO, WBFS) and offers per-game settings, a clean interface, and good performance.
items.author: Various

items.name: GC Linux alpha
items.description: An experimental port of Linux for the GameCube and Wii. This is a developer tool for enthusiasts who want to experiment with running a Linux distribution on the hardware. It is not a user-friendly application for everyday use.
items.author: Various

items.name: GC Memory Manager
items.description: A tool for managing GameCube memory card files (.raw). It allows you to backup, restore, and edit saved games directly from your Wii or in a development environment [citation:10].
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Homebrew Browser
items.description: A community-driven application that allows you to browse and download homebrew apps directly from an online repository. The Open Shop Channel is a modern revival of this concept, providing a centralized place to discover new software [citation:12].
items.author: Various

items.name: loadMii
items.description: A lightweight loader that starts homebrew applications from an SD card or USB drive. It supports many formats and can automatically detect the correct boot.dol, making it a simple and reliable way to run software on the Wii.
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Nintendont
items.description: The definitive GameCube loader for Wii and vWii. It runs on all Wii models, including those without GameCube controller ports, and supports ISO, RVZ, and WBFS formats. It features virtual memory cards, USB controller support, and per-game settings, making it an essential tool for playing GC games on a Wii [citation:9][citation:12].
items.author: Crediar, FIX94

items.name: Pimp My Wii
items.description: A powerful system tweak tool that installs missing or outdated IOS/titles, installs cIOS and mIOS, and manages custom channels. It is a go-to utility for setting up a modded Wii for homebrew [citation:3].
items.author: Attila

items.name: PriiLoader
items.description: An advanced bootloader that replaces the Wii's system menu with a more flexible one. It can prevent and fix user-level bricks, block updates, enable region-free gameplay, and launch homebrew directly [citation:3].
items.author: DacoTaco

items.name: Settings Editor GUI
items.description: A graphical editor for Wii system settings. It allows you to change region, language, screen resolution, and other hidden system parameters, useful for customization and region-free play.
items.author: Unknown

items.name: USB Loader GX
items.description: The premier backup loader for Wii games. It offers a beautiful, customizable interface with support for themes, cover art, and cheats. It integrates directly with Nintendont for GameCube games and Wiimmfi for online play [citation:12].
items.author: GX Team

items.name: VBA GX
items.description: A Game Boy Advance emulator for the Wii. It supports GBA, GBC, and GB ROMs, and includes features like save states and cheat codes. It is a well-regarded retro emulator for the platform [citation:6].
items.author: Various

items.name: WiiBrowser
items.description: A web browser for the Wii. It supports basic HTML and JavaScript, allowing you to browse the internet on your console. While not as full-featured as modern browsers, it can be useful for quick web searches [citation:6].
items.author: Various

items.name: WiiFlow
items.description: A stylish and highly customizable USB loader. It features animated banners, game covers, and a sleek interface, and supports many themes and plugins to enhance the experience [citation:9].
items.author: Fledge

items.name: WiiMC
items.description: A comprehensive media center for the Wii. It can play video and audio files from SD/USB, stream internet content, and display images. Notably, WiiMC can restore DVD playback, which Nintendo disabled to avoid licensing fees [citation:12].
items.author: WiiMC Team

items.name: WiiTweet
items.description: A Twitter client for the Wii. It allows you to post tweets, read timelines, and engage with your followers from your console. A nostalgic way to stay connected, though the underlying API may no longer be functional.
items.author: Various

items.name: WiiXplorer
items.description: A powerful file manager for the Wii. It supports FTP, SMB, and USB drives, and allows you to copy, move, rename, and delete files. It can also extract archives and view images, making it essential for managing homebrew files [citation:12].
items.author: Various

items.name: WSM Player
items.description: A media player for the Wii that supports a variety of audio and video formats. It can play files from an SD card or USB drive and offers a straightforward interface for media consumption.
items.author: Various
